title: AI Algorithm to Predict Acute Coronary Syndrome in Prehospital Cardiac Care: Retrospective Cohort Study.
summary: A machine-learning algorithm using prehospital cardiac-care data predicted acute coronary syndrome and was evaluated against subsequent clinical diagnoses in a retrospective cohort.
ai_technology: A supervised text-classification model analyzes prehospital emergency-service records to predict acute coronary syndrome before emergency-department arrival.

evidence.tested: In 7,458 retrospective EMS cases, the AI model had 99.5% sensitivity and 11% specificity, versus 99.5% sensitivity and 1% specificity under usual care.
evidence.unknown: The retrospective single-condition proof of concept does not evaluate other life-threatening diagnoses; prospective validation is required.
evidence.ai_role: A supervised text-classification model analyzes prehospital emergency-service records to predict acute coronary syndrome before emergency-department arrival.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
